code.value:
MATCH (u:Node)-[:Wire {t: 1}]-(v:Node)
WHERE ((u.t = 1 AND v.t = 1) OR (u.t = 2 AND v.t = 2))
  AND id(u) < id(v)
WITH u, v
LIMIT 1
CREATE (merged:Node {
  phase: coalesce(u.phase, 0) + coalesce(v.phase, 0),
  t: u.t,
  graph_id: coalesce(u.graph_id, v.graph_id),
  id: coalesce(u.id, v.id),
  qubit: coalesce(u.qubit, v.qubit),
  row: coalesce(u.row, v.row)
})
DETACH DELETE u, v
RETURN count(merged) AS merged

items.title: Change color age - mark
items.description: Mark red spiders for AGE-safe to_gh rewrite

code.value:
MATCH (n:Node)
WHERE n.t = 2
SET n._to_gh_mark = true
RETURN count(n) AS marked

items.title: Change color age - recolor
items.description: Recolor marked red spiders to green

code.value:
MATCH (n:Node {_to_gh_mark: true})
SET n.t = 1
RETURN count(n) AS recolored

items.title: Change color age - toggle wires
items.description: Toggle edge types around marked spiders (1 <-> 2)

code.value:
MATCH (n:Node {_to_gh_mark: true})-[w:Wire]-()
WHERE w.t IN [1, 2]
WITH DISTINCT w
SET w.t = CASE w.t WHEN 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END
RETURN count(w) AS toggled

MATCH (n:Node {_to_gh_mark: true})
REMOVE n._to_gh_mark
RETURN count(n) AS cleaned

items.title: Spider fusion age - self loop cleanup
items.description: Remove ZX self-loops and add pi phase for odd hadamard self-loops

code.value:
MATCH (v:Node)-[r:Wire]-(v)
WHERE v.t IN [1, 2]
WITH v,
     count(r) AS self_loop_count,
     sum(CASE WHEN r.t = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hadamard_count
WHERE self_loop_count > 0
SET v.phase = coalesce(v.phase, 0) + CASE WHEN hadamard_count % 2 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
WITH v
MATCH (v)-[loop_edge:Wire]-(v)
DELETE loop_edge
RETURN count(DISTINCT v) AS vertices_processed
